in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The God of Ayurveda and Healing, the preserver of the Vedic knowledge of medicines, and the giver of health and happiness

in_hindi.name: दिवांशु
in_hindi.long_meaning: Divaantar ke paas hua, meaning the one who is with Dhanvantari, the God of Ayurveda

in_tamil.name: திவாங்ஷு
in_tamil.long_meaning: Thivan tharam avan, meaning the one who is with Thivaan, a form of Lord Shiva

in_telugu.name: దీవాంశు
in_telugu.long_meaning: DheevanTari parishattayudu, meaning the one who is with DheevanTari, a form of Lord Vishnu

in_marathi.name: Divanshu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the House
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divanshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divanshu is a Sanskrit and Hindu name that means 'Lord of the House'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'diva' (god) and 'anshu' (house or abode). The name signifies the presence of the divine in one's home and life.
